description: After you committed and pushed the fix: give the branch and the commit sha. The Deployer reads the commit from the git host, checks the change (no CI, agent settings or .env files; no secrets) and then deploys it, or opens a pull request for the person to ship, depending on the project's settings.

branch.description: The branch you pushed to (the brief says which)

note.description: One or two sentences on what you changed

sha.description: The commit you pushed (git rev-parse HEAD)

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.

name: report_fix
title: Report the fix you pushed
